But, you know, alcohol, so we kept drinking, I had a corporate card so we bought shots for the whole bar, I convinced the bartender to start playing some T-Swift (my drunken pleasure), most of the bar started singing along with me, (this was golden age T-Swift, much catchier), Corporate man was thoroughly loving life. And then in the midst of this wreck these two drunk cougars made their move on us. "Whatever" I thought. Their just flirting at a bar, no big, I flirt back. So we were not dating, we hadn't been intimate, we were by no means exclusive, and technically speaking I could have done whatever I wanted and it would have been fair game. Cougar 2 says something along the lines of "he doesn't wanna do anything. He's with someone or some shit." In the hallway he asks me why I won't "fuck her" (yes, he phrased it like that). I try to explain my weird wannabe-relationship with my ex and how I feel uncomfortable sleeping with another women. So I'm suddenly real intimidated because he's my would-be-client and I cave and say okay, but had no intention to follow through, but also had not yet thought up an escape plan because well, I was drunk, and not the best planner at that moment. So he pats me on the back and we walk back in the room, and he says "party time" or some shit like that. Suddenly, it hits me, my escape plan, as I'm walking back in the room staring at these cougars I burst out with - "You know what. I can't get it up. I'm sorry. I'm embarrassed.
